verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents its own AI insight features on transcribed audio: LLM-generated summaries, sentiment tracking, topic identification and auto-summarized chapters. These are each covered only by one-line descriptions. Nothing shows proactive suggestions or recommendations, or how these insights appear inside the web platform rather than through the API. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, in-product UI for viewing insights, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Track sentiment across a transcribed conversation.
Identify what is being talked about in audio and video.
Split long recordings into automatically summarized chapters.
